_note: Shared 2025 facts (verified 3-0). One fact, multiple per-country hooks. Countries without a hook but listed in world_modifier.deltas feel a background effect (COUNTRY_SCENARIOS.md §2.4). Figure keys match each country's roster.

globals.title: DeepSeek shock: China's cheap frontier AI
globals.fact: In late January 2025 China's DeepSeek released a frontier-level AI model trained at a fraction of US costs, triggering a record ~$1 trillion rout in US tech stocks (Nvidia alone shed ~$600bn in a day) and upending the AI race.

usa.title: DeepSeek wipes $1T off US tech
usa.dilemma: Double down on US AI dominance (Stargate, deregulation, please Big Tech) or clamp down with harsher chip-export controls to choke China's rise?
usa.hidden_info: Whether DeepSeek's cheap-training claims hold, and how fast markets recover.

stakeholder_positions.elites: The panic is overblown — back our labs with capital and looser rules, not export bans that gut our chip sales.
stakeholder_positions.sec_treasury: A trillion-dollar rout rattles confidence; steady the markets first.

china.title: DeepSeek humbles Silicon Valley
china.dilemma: Trumpet the breakthrough as proof of self-reliance (national pride, invites tougher US sanctions) or play it down to avoid provoking Washington?
china.hidden_info: How hard the US will retaliate on advanced chips.

stakeholder_positions.econ_czar: Proof the self-reliance strategy works — now fund the entire stack.
stakeholder_positions.elites: Quiet wins are safer; loud ones bring sanctions down on our chips.

globals.title: The Oval Office blow-up with Zelensky
globals.fact: On Feb 28, 2025 the White House meeting with Ukraine's Zelensky collapsed into a public confrontation; he left without signing the planned minerals deal, reshaping the Russia–Ukraine diplomacy.

usa.title: Showdown with Zelensky in the Oval Office
usa.dilemma: Strong-arm Ukraine toward a deal (and minerals), or stand by an ally and keep pressure on Moscow?
usa.hidden_info: Whether Putin will actually deal, and how Europe reacts.

stakeholder_positions.sec_state: Wants leverage without losing the alliance.

russia.title: The West cracks over Ukraine
russia.dilemma: Exploit the US–Ukraine rift for gains, or play it cautious to avoid overreach?

stakeholder_positions.foreign: A historic opening to split the West.

france.title: Europe scrambles to backstop Kyiv
france.dilemma: Lead a European security guarantee for Ukraine, or defer to Washington?

world_modifier.label: Grain & energy jitters from the Ukraine rift

globals.title: 'Liberation Day' tariffs upend world trade
globals.fact: On April 2, 2025 the US imposed a 10% universal tariff plus steep 'reciprocal' tariffs; markets crashed, a 90-day pause followed for most (April 9), but China was escalated to an effective 145% before a May truce to 30%.

usa.title: 'Liberation Day': you blow up world trade
usa.dilemma: Impose sweeping tariffs as leverage and a pro-base flex, or hold back to avoid a market crash, inflation and retaliation?
usa.hidden_info: How hard markets fall, who retaliates, and whether the courts let it stand.

stakeholder_positions.sec_treasury: Ready to negotiate from strength, but warns of market panic.

china.title: America hits you with 145% tariffs
china.dilemma: Retaliate hard to look strong, or negotiate a truce to protect growth?

stakeholder_positions.foreign: A truce buys time to build self-reliance.

france.title: Washington slaps 20% on EU exports
france.dilemma: Back EU-wide retaliation, or seek a national exemption?

brazil.title: Caught in the US tariff wave
brazil.dilemma: Lead a BRICS-style pushback, or quietly court Washington for relief?

stakeholder_positions.foreign: Use BRICS to dilute US pressure.

globals.title: The Twelve-Day War: strikes on Iran's nuclear sites
globals.fact: On June 21-22, 2025 the US struck three Iranian nuclear sites (Fordow, Natanz, Isfahan); a ceasefire was announced June 24. Oil prices spiked and the Strait of Hormuz risk loomed.

usa.title: Strike Iran's nuclear sites alongside Israel?
usa.dilemma: Join the war to destroy Iran's nuclear program, or hold back to avoid escalation, an oil shock and a revolt of your 'America First' base?
usa.hidden_info: The true damage to the sites and how Iran retaliates.

stakeholder_positions.sec_defense: We can obliterate the program now.
stakeholder_positions.vice_president: The anti-war base will feel betrayed.

russia.title: Your ally Iran is under US bombs
russia.dilemma: Stand by Tehran and confront Washington, or stay out and reap higher oil prices?

stakeholder_positions.foreign: Higher oil funds the war chest.

china.title: Oil supply and Hormuz at risk
china.dilemma: Loudly condemn and secure oil flows, or quietly mediate to protect supply?

stakeholder_positions.econ_czar: A Hormuz disruption would hammer our economy.

world_modifier.label: Oil price shock from the Iran war
